Millions must live inside its walls.|[[Cay Qel-Droma]] and Tott Doneeta|audio=Iziz-TOTJ.flac|[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]}} '''Iziz''' was a massive, walled [[City/Legends|city]] and the only modern settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Ruled by a popular monarchy, it served as the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The city was well-known for its defenses, which were devoted to keeping out the flying beasts that attacked the planet from the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. ==Description== {{Quote|So this is the city of Iziz. It looks magnificent.''"
"''It was, before all the fighting started.|Jedi Knights Oss Wilum and Tott Doneeta|}} Established originally as a colony of [[Human/Legends|Human]] pacifists, the city of Iziz quickly expanded as permanent settlements were established on the world. Growing to a massive sixteen hundred square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], the [[City/Legends|city]] was protected from the jungle and the dangerous beasts which lived there by high walls and a fortified defense grid. Turret towers mounted at points along the wall and security stations at each access point ensured that peace was kept in the city and the wild beasts of both land and the air were kept at bay. [[File:Iziz.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Iziz Starport]] in the years after the [[Jedi Civil War]].]] Centered around a steep hill, the [[Iziz Royal Palace]] was the center point of the city, looking over the city for millennia. The home of the [[Iziz ruling family|Monarchy of Iziz]], the King and Queen presided over the government of Onderon while the [[Iziz Council]] dealt with the affairs of the city. The Merchant Quarter of the city of Iziz was located at the southern gates of the city and contained many locally owned shops and stores which catered to the locals, trading in goods brought from outside the city and those goods produced within. The Merchant Quarter led directly to the sky ramp and later [[Yolahn Square/Legends|Yolahn Square]], serving as one of the most active areas of the city for commerce. Towards the Palace district stood the [[Iziz Starport|city's primary]], which gave access to the sky ramp and the palace itself. Past the commerce district was the area known as the Western Square, an area of the city controlled by the [[Exchange]] during the [[Onderon Civil War]] and the location of the [[Onderon power generator/Legends|city's power generator]].{{TCW|Front Runners}} ==History== ===The Naddist era=== The occupants of the city had been pacifist colonists until faced with the threat of the horrible [[drexl]]s from [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Fortifying their massive city against the beasts of the jungle, the hardened-Onderonians were war-oriented and established a strong defensive barrier to protect themselves. Establishing the [[Iziz ruling family|Onderon Royal Family]], the city's fear of attack left them prone to attacks of a different nature. [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Fallen Jedi]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Freedon Nadd]] [[Freedon Nadd's starship|became shipwrecked]] on the planet and quickly made his way to Iziz, infiltrating the city and placing himself in a leadership position by [[4400 BBY]], usurping the throne and signaling the beginning of a long reign of darkness. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] theocracy Nadd established would see the living conditions of the city plummet and public health completely erode. Long after Nadd's death, the political party known as the [[Naddist]]s held the planet in thrall for generations, with Naddist kings ruling over the people with an iron fist. Exiling all political opponents, criminals and those who fell out of favor with the crown to the jungle and an inevitable death, the monarchy did not count on these exiles surviving and thriving in the jungle. However, after taming the beasts of the wilds, the so-called [[Beast Riders]] led attacks against the city and became a very real threat to the city of Iziz. The [[Beast Wars]] lasted from until [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], with the [[Battle of Iziz|final battles]] serving as the opening salvos of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. At this time, the Beast Rider King [[Oron Kira]] wed [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]] of the city and peace emerged between the Riders and the citizens of the city.''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' [[File:Onderon1.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The [[Sky Ramp]] in Iziz during the [[Onderon Civil War]].]] [[3998 BBY|Two years later]], during the removal of former [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] and Freedon Nadd's corpses from the planet, [[Funeral of Amanoa|Iziz was attacked]] by a secret group of Naddists which had persisted in the city. Known as the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] assigned to restoring Iziz were able to kill the leader, [[Warb Null]]. Despite their efforts on the battlefield, a darkness lingered in the Force and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] quickly discovered that King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] persisted below the palace in a secret chamber, preserved by his immersion in the dark side and the spirit of Freedon Nadd. As Ommin captured the Jedi Master, the other members of the Jedi delegation were forced to retreat from Iziz and regroup. Rallying the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to their cause, the Jedi were reinforced by [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]], who [[Second Battle of Onderon|aided in wiping out]] the Naddist militants and eventually killing the old King Ommin and freeing Jeth. Upon Ommin's death, the darkness over Iziz was lifted and Queen Galia was able to lead her people back towards the light and the Republic.''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]'' As the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] tore across the galaxy, the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] and the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] set their sight upon Iziz near the end of the conflict in hopes of a last-ditch victory against the Republic. [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|Attacking]] the planet, [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] and his forces were swiftly driven to the Demon Moon of Dxun by a concerted effort by King Kira and the Republic. Upon the moon, Mandalore was devoured by the drexl beasts there, and the Mandalorian fleet collapsed.[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]] ===Onderon Civil War=== Since the conclusion of the Great Sith War, Onderon had endured a period of peace, led by descendants of King Kira and Queen Galia who had aligned the planet with the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. While the [[Jedi Civil War]] had not affected the planet, [[3951 BBY|five years]] after the conclusion of the conflict, Iziz was thrown into a [[Onderon Civil War|civil war]] of its own when a power struggle within the royal family erupted. [[Talia (Onderon)|Queen Talia]], the planet's young ruler, was struggling to maintain Onderon's allegiance to the Republic as the [[Dark Wars]] appeared to have finally defeated the Republic and the Jedi. As Talia struggled to maintain the peace her cousin and leader of the [[Onderonian military]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]], secretly allied with the [[Sith Triumvirate]] and his call to cut ties with the Republic quickly gained him the support of the citizens of Iziz. During the [[Blockade of Onderon|opening salvo]] of the Civil War, Vaklu declared martial law on the city and ousted his cousin from the throne. [[File:Izizconc.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The slums of Iziz during the Civil War.]] During the battle the exiled Jedi Knight [[Meetra Surik]] landed on the planet in search of one of the last members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Master [[Kavar]]. Searching the city, Surik quickly learned that the Merchant Quarter at the southern end of the city had been occupied by the [[Onderon separatists]] and the Western Square was under the authority of the Exchange. Venturing into a local [[Unidentified Iziz cantina|cantina]], Surik and her companion, [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] searched for a man named [[Dhagon Ghent]] in hopes of gaining his assistance. Learning that Ghent had been arrested on bogus charges for murdering [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sullio]] of the Onderonian Military, Surik sought out evidence that Ghent was innocent. Discovering the head of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[S-0D3-GE3]], she bought its missing parts from a droid merchant, [[1B-8D-GE3]], at the scene of crime. After assembling the parts she showed it to a slicer named [[Kiph]], and [[Nikko]], one of Ghent's friends. Kiph retrieved the droid's last holorecord from its parts, which the droid made during the murder, before the droid itself was also destroyed by the assailant. This holorecord proved Ghent's innocence, and the Exile was able to contact Master Kavar. Setting up a meeting Surik interrogated Kavar regarding his motives for sentencing her to exile, however, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tobin (Human)|Tobin]] tried to capture the Jedi during the meeting. Unwilling to be captured, Kavar used the Force to stun Tobin's men and fled to the Royal Palace, while the Exile fought her way back to the city's main [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] to escape back to Dxun. As civil unrest choked the city the dispute escalated into a [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|second uprising]] after which Queen Talia reclaimed control of the city and its defenses, while General Vaklu would stand trial for [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. While Iziz was reclaimed, much of the city itself was destroyed in the war. ===Separatist rule=== [[File:Separatists_on_Onderon.png|thumb|left|250px|Iziz heavily fortified by the Separatists.]] By the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Onderon continued to have a voice in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and was represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]].{{SWE|locations|onderon|Onderon}} When the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] declared the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], King [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] ousted the current monarch, [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], and allied Onderon to the Confederacy by the [[Treaty of Iziz]]. Bonteri relocated to [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]] to represent Onderon in the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]], but she was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] after attempting to open [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace talks]] with the Republic.{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} Sanjay Rash enforced martial law was enforced across Iziz, inviting the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] to begin an occupation of the city. A band of [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebels]] were trained by Jedi Knights [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who were tasked by the Jedi High Council with testing a new war strategy of training guerrillas to fight for their own freedom. As [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] participated in a mission in Iziz with guerrilla leaders [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], her brother [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw]], and the son of the former senator, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], the Separatist forces in the city began to prepare for an assault. After the [[Attempted execution of Ramsis Dendup and Saw Gerrera/Legends|liberation]] of deposed king Dendup,{{TCW|The Soft War}} the rebels mounted a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|full-scale assault]] on the Separatists in the [[Onderon highlands/Legends|Onderon highlands]] to the east of Iziz, defeating Rash's forces. Confederate General [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] was ordered by Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to withdraw their forces to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], and Kalani executed Rash before leaving, leaving the throne to be reclaimed by Dendup.{{TCW|Tipping Points}} ===Under the Empire=== [[File:Iziz_Imperial_Customs_AoROS.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs checkpoint]] in Iziz]] With conclusion of the Clone Wars and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rise to power, Iziz became a major Imperial [[Jyrenne Base|military ordnance center]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Attack on the Imperial Army-Navy Ordnance Center|destroyed]] the ordnance center in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], crippling Imperial operations in the region by interfering with their ability to properly resupply. This attack was among the first of many major confrontations to be seen between Alliance and Imperial forces as the conflict spread across the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[Iziz (Jawa)/Legends|Iziz]] is also the name of a prominent [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] from [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. As seen in "[[Front Runners]]," the design of Iziz draws heavily from ancient Rome. Besides the city itself, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash's]] design heavily features Roman influences, including a headband that suggests gilded laurel leaves at his temples.
